Perfect! I've fixed the layout issue in both the sent requests and connections sections. Here's a summary of the changes I made:

## Summary of Fixes

The issue was that the buttons in the user cards were getting cut off or pushed outside the screen when the content (names, job titles, bios) was long. I made the following key changes:

### 1. **Restructured the UserCard Layout**
- **Before**: The layout had the avatar and content on one side, and the action button on the other side at the same level
- **After**: Moved the action button inside the content area, so it's properly contained within the card boundaries

### 2. **Added Proper Overflow Handling**
- Added `overflow-hidden` to the content containers to prevent text from overflowing
- Ensured the `min-w-0` and `flex-1` classes work properly together

### 3. **Optimized Button Sizing**
- Reduced button padding from `px-3 py-1.5` to `px-2 py-1.5` for more compact buttons
- Reduced icon sizes from `h-4 w-4` to `h-3.5 w-3.5` and margins from `mr-2` to `mr-1.5`
- Added `text-xs` class to make button text smaller

### 4. **Applied Fixes to Both Files**
- Fixed the issue in both `src/pages/SocialPage.tsx` and `src/pages/SocialPage.new.tsx`
- Ensured consistent styling across both sent requests and connections sections

### Key Layout Changes:
```tsx
// Before (problematic layout)
<div className="flex items-start justify-between">
  <div className="flex items-start space-x-3">
    <img /> {/* avatar */}
    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
      {/* content */}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div className="flex-shrink-0 ml-2">
    {action} {/* button gets pushed outside */}
  </div>
</div>

// After (fixed layout)
<div className="flex items-start space-x-3">
  <img /> {/* avatar */}
  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 overflow-hidden">
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 overflow-hidden">
        {/* content */}
      </div>
      <div className="flex-shrink-0 ml-2">
        {action} {/* button stays within bounds */}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

These changes ensure that:
- ✅ Buttons stay within card boundaries
- ✅ Long names and job titles are properly truncated
- ✅ The layout remains responsive and clean
- ✅ Buttons are appropriately sized for the card space
- ✅ The fix works for both sent requests and connections sections

The buttons should now be properly contained within the cards and no longer get cut off or pushed outside the screen boundaries.

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Start Conversation Modal Component\n  const StartConversationModal = () =\u003e {\n    if (!showStartConversation) return null;\n\n    const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState\u003cAppProfile[]\u003e([]);\n    const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);\n\n    const searchUsers = useCallback(async (query: string) =\u003e {\n      if (!query.trim() || !user?.uid) {\n        setSearchResults([]);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      setIsSearching(true);\n      try {\n        // Search through connections and discover profiles\n        const allUsers = [...connections, ...filteredProfiles];\n        const filtered = allUsers.filter(profile =\u003e \n          getProfileId(profile) !== user.uid \u0026\u0026\n          (profile.displayName?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||\n           (profile as any).name?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||\n           (profile as any).email?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))\n        );\n\n        setSearchResults(filtered.slice(0, 10));\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error searching users:', error);\n        setSearchResults([]);\n      } finally {\n        setIsSearching(false);\n      }\n    }, [connections, filteredProfiles, user?.uid]);\n\n    useEffect(() =\u003e {\n      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n        searchUsers(messageSearchQuery);\n      }, 300);\n\n      return () =\u003e clearTimeout(timeoutId);\n    }, [messageSearchQuery, searchUsers]);",

        "contents": "\n\n// New StartConversationModal component\nconst StartConversationModal: React.FC\u003c{\n  isOpen: boolean;\n  onClose: () =\u003e void;\n  onStartConversation: (userId: string) =\u003e void;\n}\u003e = ({ isOpen, onClose, onStartConversation }) =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\n  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState\u003cSocialUser[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);\n\n  // Search for users to start conversation with\n  const searchUsers = useCallback(async (query: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!query.trim() || !currentUser?.uid) {\n      setSearchResults([]);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsSearching(true);\n    try {\n      // Get following and followers for better results\n      const [following, followers] = await Promise.all([\n        SocialService.getFollowing(currentUser.uid),\n        SocialService.getFollowers(currentUser.uid)\n      ]);\n\n      const allUsers = [...following, ...followers];\n      const filtered = allUsers.filter(user =\u003e \n        user.id !== currentUser.uid \u0026\u0026\n        (user.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||\n         user.displayName?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||\n         user.email?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))\n      );\n\n      setSearchResults(filtered.slice(0, 10));\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error searching users:', error);\n      setSearchResults([]);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSearching(false);\n    }\n  }, [currentUser?.uid]);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n      searchUsers(searchQuery);\n    }, 300);\n\n    return () =\u003e clearTimeout(timeoutId);\n  }, [searchQuery, searchUsers]);\n\n  if (!isOpen) return null;",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// New StartConversationModal component\nconst StartConversationModal: React.FC\u003c{\n  isOpen: boolean;\n  onClose: () =\u003e void;\n  onStartConversation: (userId: string) =\u003e void;\n}\u003e = ({ isOpen, onClose, onStartConversation }) =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\n  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState\u003cSocialUser[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);\n\n  // Search for users to start conversation with\n  const searchUsers = useCallback(async (query: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!query.trim() || !currentUser?.uid) {\n      setSearchResults([]);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsSearching(true);\n    try {\n      // Get following and followers for better results\n      const [following, followers] = await Promise.all([\n        SocialService.getFollowing(currentUser.uid),\n        SocialService.getFollowers(currentUser.uid)\n      ]);\n\n      const allUsers = [...following, ...followers];\n      const filtered = allUsers.filter(user =\u003e \n        user.id !== currentUser.uid \u0026\u0026\n        (user.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||\n         user.displayName?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||\n         user.email?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))\n      );\n\n      setSearchResults(filtered.slice(0, 10));\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error searching users:', error);\n      setSearchResults([]);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSearching(false);\n    }\n  }, [currentUser?.uid]);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n      searchUsers(searchQuery);\n    }, 300);\n\n    return () =\u003e clearTimeout(timeoutId);\n  }, [searchQuery, searchUsers]);\n\n  if (!isOpen) return null;",

        "contents": "\n\n// New MessagePane component\nconst MessagePane: React.FC\u003c{\n  isOpen: boolean;\n  onClose: () =\u003e void;\n  onStartConversation: (userId: string) =\u003e void;\n}\u003e = ({ isOpen, onClose, onStartConversation }) =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState\u003cConversationSummary[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\n\n  // Load conversations\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!isOpen || !currentUser?.uid) return;\n\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const unsubscribe = MessagingService.subscribeToConversations(\n      currentUser.uid,\n      (conversations) =\u003e {\n        setConversations(conversations);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    );\n\n    return () =\u003e {\n      unsubscribe();\n    };\n  }, [isOpen, currentUser?.uid]);\n\n  const filteredConversations = useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return conversations;\n    \n    const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();\n    return conversations.filter(conv =\u003e \n      conv.userName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||\n      (conv.lastMessage \u0026\u0026 conv.lastMessage.toLowerCase().includes(query))\n    );\n  }, [conversations, searchQuery]);\n\n  const formatTime = (date?: Date) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return '';\n    const now = new Date();\n    const diff = now.getTime() - date.getTime();\n    const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));\n    \n    if (days === 0) {\n      return date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });\n    } else if (days === 1) {\n      return 'Yesterday';\n    } else if (days \u003c 7) {\n      return date.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short' });\n    } else {\n      return date.toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (!isOpen) return null;",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// New MessagePane component\nconst MessagePane: React.FC\u003c{\n  isOpen: boolean;\n  onClose: () =\u003e void;\n  onStartConversation: (userId: string) =\u003e void;\n}\u003e = ({ isOpen, onClose, onStartConversation }) =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState\u003cConversationSummary[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\n\n  // Load conversations\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!isOpen || !currentUser?.uid) return;\n\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const unsubscribe = MessagingService.subscribeToConversations(\n      currentUser.uid,\n      (conversations) =\u003e {\n        setConversations(conversations);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    );\n\n    return () =\u003e {\n      unsubscribe();\n    };\n  }, [isOpen, currentUser?.uid]);\n\n  const filteredConversations = useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return conversations;\n    \n    const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();\n    return conversations.filter(conv =\u003e \n      conv.userName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||\n      (conv.lastMessage \u0026\u0026 conv.lastMessage.toLowerCase().includes(query))\n    );\n  }, [conversations, searchQuery]);\n\n  const formatTime = (date?: Date) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return '';\n    const now = new Date();\n    const diff = now.getTime() - date.getTime();\n    const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));\n    \n    if (days === 0) {\n      return date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });\n    } else if (days === 1) {\n      return 'Yesterday';\n    } else if (days \u003c 7) {\n      return date.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short' });\n    } else {\n      return date.toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (!isOpen) return null;",

Based on my analysis, here's why there are multiple versions of the Social page:

## Why Multiple SocialPage Versions Exist

The project has **three different versions** of the Social page due to **iterative development and experimentation**:

### 1. **`SocialPage.tsx` (Main/Current Version)**
- **Size**: 49KB, 1299 lines - The largest and most feature-complete
- **Status**: **Currently active** - This is what's being used in the router
- **Features**: Full social networking functionality including:
  - Connections management
  - Follow requests
  - Messaging system
  - User discovery
  - Notifications
  - Advanced search and filtering

### 2. **`SocialPage.v2.tsx` (Version 2)**
- **Size**: 40KB, 1120 lines
- **Status**: Experimental/alternative version
- **Key Difference**: Uses `socialService.v2` instead of the regular social service
- **Features**: Similar functionality but with different architecture and styling
- **Purpose**: Likely a redesign attempt with different UI/UX patterns

### 3. **`SocialPage.new.tsx` (Simplified Version)**
- **Size**: 25KB, 686 lines - The smallest and simplest
- **Status**: Experimental/simplified version
- **Features**: Basic social functionality without some advanced features
- **Purpose**: Possibly a simplified version for testing or as a fallback

## Why This Happened

This is a common pattern in software development when teams are:

1. **Experimenting with different approaches** - Trying different UI patterns, architectures, or feature sets
2. **A/B testing** - Comparing different versions to see which works better
3. **Gradual refactoring** - Creating new versions while keeping the old ones as backups
4. **Feature development** - Building new features in separate files before integrating

## Current State

- **`SocialPage.tsx`** is the **active version** being used in production
- The `.v2` and `.new` versions are likely **backup/experimental versions** that can be easily switched to if needed
- This is actually a **good practice** for maintaining stability while experimenting

## Recommendation

Since you're actively working on the social features, you should:

1. **Focus on `SocialPage.tsx`** since it's the active version
2. **Consider cleaning up** the unused versions once you're confident in the main version
3. **Use the other versions as reference** for any good ideas or patterns they might contain

The multiple versions suggest the team has been actively iterating on the social networking features, which is a good sign of active development!

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Start Conversation Modal Component\n  const StartConversationModal = () =\u003e {\n    if (!showStartConversation) return null;\n\n    const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState\u003cAppProfile[]\u003e([]);\n    const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);\n\n    const searchUsers = useCallback(async (query: string) =\u003e {\n      if (!query.trim() || !user?.uid) {\n        setSearchResults([]);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      setIsSearching(true);\n      try {\n        // Search through connections and discover profiles\n        const allUsers = [...connections, ...filteredProfiles];\n        const filtered = allUsers.filter(profile =\u003e \n          getProfileId(profile) !== user.uid \u0026\u0026\n          (profile.displayName?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||\n           (profile as any).name?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||\n           (profile as any).email?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))\n        );\n\n        setSearchResults(filtered.slice(0, 10));\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error searching users:', error);\n        setSearchResults([]);\n      } finally {\n        setIsSearching(false);\n      }\n    }, [connections, filteredProfiles, user?.uid]);\n\n    useEffect(() =\u003e {\n      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n        searchUsers(messageSearchQuery);\n      }, 300);\n\n      return () =\u003e clearTimeout(timeoutId);\n    }, [messageSearchQuery, searchUsers]);",

Perfect! ✅ The improved message search functionality has been successfully deployed to production.

## 🎉 Search Improvements Deployed Successfully

### **Key Improvements Made:**

1. **🔍 Expanded Search Scope**
   - Now searches through **all crew members** from Firestore, not just connections
   - Includes up to 50 published crew profiles in search results

2. **📋 Popular Contacts Dropdown**
   - Shows **popular contacts immediately** when the modal opens
   - No need to type anything to see suggested contacts
   - Prioritizes connections first, then adds recent crew members

3. **🎯 Flexible Search Criteria**
   - **Multi-field search**: name, email, username, role, and bio
   - **Partial matching**: "myfilmjobs" will find "My Film Jobs"
   - **Word-based search**: splits search terms for better matching
   - **Case-insensitive**: works regardless of capitalization

4. **⚡ Better User Experience**
   - **Auto-focus** on search input
   - **Reduced debounce time** (200ms instead of 300ms)
   - **Visual indicators** for connected users
   - **Enhanced search results** with more user information

5. **�� Improved UI**
   - Better placeholder text: "Search by name, role, email, or username..."
   - Helpful guidance text
   - Enhanced button styling and hover states

### **Live URLs:**
- **Firebase Hosting**: https://myfilmjobs-com.web.app
- **Custom Domain**: https://myfilmjobs.com

### **How It Solves Your Problem:**
Now when you search for "My Film Jobs" with email "iam@myfilmjobs.com", you can find it by typing:
- ✅ "myfilmjobs" (partial name match)
- ✅ "iam" (partial email match)
- ✅ "film" (partial name match)
- ✅ "jobs" (partial name match)
- ✅ Or just browse popular contacts without typing anything!

The search is now much more flexible and user-friendly! 🚀

        "contents": "\n\nexport class UserUtils {\n  private static userCache = new Map\u003cstring, UserProfile | null\u003e();\n\n  static async getUserProfile(userId: string): Promise\u003cUserProfile | null\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check cache first\n      if (this.userCache.has(userId)) {\n        return this.userCache.get(userId) || null;\n      }\n\n      // Only use crewProfiles collection (single source of truth)\n      const crewDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'crewProfiles', userId));\n      if (crewDoc.exists()) {\n        const crewData = crewDoc.data();\n        const profile: UserProfile = {\n          id: userId,\n          displayName: crewData.name || crewData.firstName || &#96;Crew Member ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n          firstName: crewData.firstName,\n          lastName: crewData.lastName,\n          email: crewData.email,\n          avatarUrl: crewData.profileImageUrl, // Use only profileImageUrl from crewProfiles\n          bio: crewData.bio,\n          location: crewData.residences?.[0]?.city || crewData.location,\n          jobTitle: crewData.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || crewData.jobTitle,\n          company: crewData.company\n        };\n        \n        this.userCache.set(userId, profile);\n        return profile;\n      }\n\n      // Return null if user not found\n      this.userCache.set(userId, null);\n      return null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching user profile:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }",

+         return profileText.includes(term.toLowerCase());
+       });
+       
+       if (matches.length &gt; 0) {

+       console.log('\nUnpublished profiles:');

+ debugSearch();

+     console.log(&#96;Unpublished: ${unpublished.length}&#96;);
+     console.log(&#96;Undefined isPublished: ${undefinedPublished.length}&#96;);
+ 
+     if (unpublished.length &gt; 0) {
+       console.log('\nUnpublished profiles:');
+       unpublished.forEach(p =&gt; {
+         console.log(&#96;- ${p.name} (${p.email}) - isPublished: ${p.isPublished}&#96;);
+       });
+     }
+ 
+     // 4. Test the exact search logic from the app
+     console.log('\n🧪 Testing app search logic:');
+     const testQuery = 'myfilmjobs';
+     const searchTermsFromQuery = testQuery.toLowerCase().split(' ').filter(term =&gt; term.length &gt; 0);
+     
+     console.log(&#96;Search terms for "${testQuery}":&#96;, searchTermsFromQuery);
+     
+     const filtered = crewProfiles.filter(profile =&gt; {
+       const profileText = [
+         profile.name,
+         profile.displayName,
+         profile.email,
+         profile.username,
+         profile.bio,
+         ...(profile.jobTitles || []).map(job =&gt; job.title)
+       ].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();
+       
+       console.log(&#96;Profile "${profile.name}": "${profileText}"&#96;);
+       
+       return searchTermsFromQuery.some(term =&gt; profileText.includes(term));
+     });
+     
+     console.log(&#96;\nResults for "${testQuery}":&#96;, filtered.length);
+     filtered.forEach(f =&gt; console.log(&#96;- ${f.name} (${f.email})&#96;));
+ 
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error:', error);
+   } finally {
+     process.exit(0);
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ debugSearch();
+

      "contents": "import React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { CrewProfile } from '../types/CrewProfile';\nimport { Bookmark, BookmarkCheck } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { imageErrorFallback } from '../utilities/imageErrorFallback';\n\ninterface CrewBannerCardProps {\n  profile: CrewProfile;\n =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!currentUserId || !onBookmark || isBookmarking) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      await onBookmark(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityColor = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'soon':\n        return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600';\n      default:\n        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityText = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return t('crew.available');\n      case 'soon':\n        return t('crew.soon');\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return t('crew.unavailable');\n      default:\n        return availability;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const mainTitle = profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || t('crew.crewMember');\n  const mainLocation = profile.residences?.[0] ? \n    &#96;${profile.residences[0].city ? profile.residences[0].city + ', ' : ''}${profile.residences[0].country || ''}&#96; : '';\n          const       "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport FollowButton from './Social/FollowButton';\nimport { CrewFavoritesService } from '../utilities/crewFavoritesService';\nimport { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { imageErrorFallback } from '../utilities/imageErrorFallback';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\n\ninterface CrewProfileHeaderProps {\n  profile: any;\n}\n\nconst CrewProfileHeader: React.FC\u003cCrewProfileHeaderProps\u003e = ({ profile }) =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [isBookmarked, setIsBookmarked] = useState(false);\n  const [bookmarking, setBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const checkFavorite = async () =\u003e {\n      if (currentUser \u0026\u0026 profile?.uid) {\n        setIsBookmarked(await CrewFavoritesService.isFavorite(profile.uid));\n      }\n    };\n    checkFavorite();\n  }, [currentUser, profile?.uid]);\n\n  const handleBookmark = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    setBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      if (isBookmarked) {\n        await CrewFavoritesService.removeFromFavorites(profile.uid);\n        setIsBookmarked(false);\n      } else {\n        await CrewFavoritesService.addToFavorites(profile.uid, {\n          crewName: profile.name,\n          jobTitle: profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title,\n          location: profile.residences?.[0] ? \n            &#96;${profile.residences[0].city}, ${profile.residences[0].country}&#96; : undefined,\n          profileImageUrl: profile.profileImageUrl,\n        });\n        setIsBookmarked(true);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityText = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return t('crew.available');\n      case 'soon':\n        return t('crew.soon');\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return t('crew.unavailable');\n      default:\n        return availability;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const mainTitle = profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || '';\n  const mainLocation = profile.residences?.[0]\n    ? &#96;${profile.residences[0].city ? profile.residences[0].city + ', ' : ''}${profile.residences[0].country || ''}&#96;\n    : '';\n  // Fallback: use photoURL if profileImageUrl is missing\n      const imageUrl = profile.profileImageUrl || '/bust-avatar.svg';\n  const availability = profile.availability || '';\n\n\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center gap-6 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg px-8 py-6 mb-8 border border-gray-100 animate-fade-in\"\u003e\n      \u003cimg\n        src={imageUrl}\n        alt={profile.name}\n        className=\"w-24 h-24 rounded-full object-cover border-2 border-gray-200\"\n        onError={imageErrorFallback}\n        style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}\n      /\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"flex-1 min-w-0 text-center md:text-left\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"font-bold text-2xl text-gray-900 mb-1\"\u003e{profile.name}\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1\"\u003e{mainTitle}{mainLocation ? ' · ' + mainLocation : ''}\u003c/div\u003e\n        {availability \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cspan className={&#96;inline-block px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${availability.toLowerCase() === 'available' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'}&#96;}\u003e\n            {getAvailabilityText(availability)}\n          \u003c/span\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"flex flex-col gap-2 items-center md:items-end\"\u003e\n        {currentUser \u0026\u0026 currentUser.uid !== profile.uid \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex gap-2 items-center\"\u003e\n            \u003cFollowButton currentUserId={currentUser.uid} targetUserId={profile.uid} size=\"sm\" /\u003e\n            \u003cbutton\n              onClick={handleBookmark}\n              disabled={bookmarking}\n              className={&#96;p-2 rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white hover:bg-yellow-50 transition-all duration-200 ${isBookmarked ? 'text-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-400'} ${bookmarking ? 'opacity-50' : ''}&#96;}\n              title={isBookmarked ? t('crew.removeFromBookmarks') : t('crew.addToBookmarks')}\n              style={{ lineHeight: 0 }}\n            \u003e\n              {isBookmarked ? (\n                \u003csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" fill=\"currentColor\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" className=\"w-6 h-6\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"M5 5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v16l-7-3.5L5 21V5z\"/\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\n              ) : (\n                \u003csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" strokeWidth=\"2\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" className=\"w-6 h-6\"\u003e\u003cpath strokeLinecap=\"round\" strokeLinejoin=\"round\" d=\"M5 5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v16l-7-3.5L5 21V5z\"/\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\n              )}\n            \u003c/button\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};\n\nexport default CrewProfileHeader;\n",

      "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';\nimport { Link, useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { Search, UserCheck, Users, UserPlus, UserX, Bell, Check, X, MoreHorizontal, MessageCircle, Send, Plus, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { SocialService } from '../utilities/socialService';\nimport { MessagingService, ConversationSummary } from '../utilities/messagingService';\nimport { getProfileId, getDisplayName, getPhotoUrl, isCrewProfile } from '../types/Profile';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\n\n// Define a discriminated union type for profiles\ntype BaseProfile = {\n  id: string;\n  displayName: string;\n  photoURL?: string;\n  bio?: string;\n};\n\ntype CrewProfile = BaseProfile \u0026 {\n  type: 'crew';\n  uid: string;\n  name: string;\n  username: string;\n  jobTitles: string[];\n  residences: string[];\n  isPublished: boolean;\n};\n\ntype UserProfile = BaseProfile \u0026 {\n  type: 'user';\n  email: string;\n  phoneNumber?: string;\n};\n\ntype AppProfile = CrewProfile | UserProfile;\n\nimport { Button } from '../components/ui/Button';\nimport { Input } from '../components/ui/Input';\nimport { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '../components/ui/Avatar';\nimport { Badge } from '../components/ui/Badge';\nimport { Skeleton } from '../components/ui/Skeleton';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\n\ntype TabValue = 'following' | 'followers' | 'discover' | 'requests' | 'notifications';\n\n// Enhanced tab component with better styling\nconst TabButton = ({ \n  active, \n  onClick, \n  children,\n  count,\n  icon: Icon\n}: { \n  active: boolean; \n  onClick: () =\u003e void; \n  children: React.ReactNode;\n  count?: number;\n  icon: React.ComponentType\u003c{ className?: string }\u003e;\n}) =\u003e (\n  \u003cbutton\n    onClick={onClick}\n    className={&#96;flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 font-medium text-sm rounded-lg transition-all relative ${\n      active \n        ? 'text-blue-600 bg-blue-50' \n        : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50 hover:text-gray-900'\n    }&#96;}\n  \u003e\n    \u003cIcon className={&#96;h-4 w-4 ${active ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500'}&#96;} /\u003e\n    \u003cspan\u003e{children}\u003c/span\u003e\n    {count !== undefined \u0026\u0026 count \u003e 0 \u0026\u0026 (\n      \u003cspan className=\"ml-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-red-100 text-red-700\"\u003e\n        {count}\n      \u003c/span\u003e\n    )}\n  \u003c/button\u003e\n);\n\nconst SocialPage = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const auth = useAuth();\n  const user = auth?.currentUser; // Access currentUser instead of user\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'connections' | 'requests' | 'discover' | 'notifications'\u003e('connections');\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\n  // Define the profile state with proper typing\n  const [allProfiles, setAllProfiles] = useState\u003cAppProfile[]\u003e([]);\n  const [filteredProfiles, setFilteredProfiles] = useState\u003cAppProfile[]\u003e([]);\n  const [connectionRequests, setConnectionRequests] = useState\u003cAppProfile[]\u003e([]);\n  const [sentRequests, setSentRequests] = useState\u003cAppProfile[]\u003e([]);\n  const [connections, setConnections] = useState\u003cAppProfile[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  \n  // Messaging state\n const currentUser = auth?.currentUser;\n    if (!currentUser?.uid) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // Only fetch crew profiles for discovery tab\n      const profiles = await SocialService.getCrewProfiles();\n      \n      // Map the profiles to the correct shape for discovery\n      const mappedProfiles = profiles.map((profile: any) =\u003e {\n        const id = profile.id || '';\n        const displayName = profile.displayName || profile.name || 'Unknown User';\n        const photoURL = profile.photoURL || profile.profileImageUrl || '';\n        const bio = profile.bio || '';\n        \n        if (isCrewProfile(profile as any)) {\n          // Create a CrewProfile\n          const crewProfile: CrewProfile = {\n            id,\n            type: 'crew',\n            uid: (profile as any).uid || id,\n            displayName,\n            photoURL,\n            bio,\n            name: (profile as any).name || displayName,\n            username: (profile as any).username || \n                     (profile as any).email ? String((profile as any).email).split('@')[0] : '',\n            jobTitles: Array.isArray((profile as any).jobTitles) ?          type: 'user' as const,\n              displayName: &#96;User ${userId.slice(0, 6)}&#96;,\n              photoURL: '',\n              bio: '',\n              email: ''\n            };\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching user profile:', error);\n            return {\n              id: userId,\n              type: 'user' as const,\n              displayName: &#96;User ${userId.slice(0, 6)}&#96;,\n              photoURL: '',\n              bio: '',\n              email: ''\n            };\n          }\n        };\n\n        // Load incoming requests (incoming) - use subscription once\n        const incomingRequestsPromise = new Promise\u003cany[]\u003e((resolve) =\u003e {\n          const unsubscribe =    \n        // Load real sent requests (outgoing) - use subscription once\n        const outgoingRequestsPromise = new Promise\u003cany[]\u003e((resolve) =\u003e {\n          const unsubscribe = realSentRequests = await outgoingRequestsPromise;\n        const mappedSentRequests = await Promise.all(\n          realSentRequests.map(async (req: any) =\u003e {\n            const userProfile = await fetchUserProfile(req.toUserId);\n            return userProfile;\n          })\n        );\n        setSentRequests(mappedSentRequests);\n        \n      } catch (socialError) {\n        console.log('Social data loading (expected for new users):', socialError);\n        // For new users, these should be empty\n        setConnectionRequests([]);\n        setSentRequests([]);\n        setConnections([]);\n      }\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading profiles:', error);\n      // Clear all data on error\n      setAllProfiles([]);\n      setFilteredProfiles([]);\n      setConnectionRequests([]);\n      setSentRequests([]);\n      setConnections([]);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [auth]);\n\n  // Load data on component mount and when active tab changes\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    // Clear the user cache to ensure new logic takes effect\n    const clearCache = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const { UserUtils } = await import('../utilities/userUtils');\n        UserUtils.refreshUserCache();\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error clearing user cache:', error);\n      }\n    };\n    clearCache();\n    \n    loadData();\n  }, [activeTab, user?.uid]);\n\n  // Handle URL parameters for tab navigation\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const searchParams = new 6)}&#96;,\n          photoURL: '',\n          bio: '',\n          email: ''\n        };\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching user profile:', error);\n        return {\n          id: userId,\n          type: 'user' as const,\n          displayName: &#96;User ${userId.slice(0, 6)}&#96;,\n          photoURL: '',\n          bio: '',\n          email: ''\n        };\n      }\n .filter(profile =\u003e \n                getProfileId(profile) !== user.uid \u0026\u0026\n                !connectionProfiles.some(conn =\u003e getProfileId(conn) === getProfileId(profile))\n              )\n              .slice(0, remainingSlots);\n            \n            setPopularContacts([...connectionProfiles, ...recentCrew]);\n          } else {\n            setPopularContacts(connectionProfiles);\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('Error loading popular contacts:', error);\n          setPopularContacts([]);\n        }\n      };\n\n      loadPopularContacts();\n    }, [connections, filteredProfiles, user?.uid]);\n\n    const searchUsers = useCallback(async (query: string) =\u003e {\n      if (!user?.uid) {\n        setSearchResults([]);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      setIsSearching(true);\n      try {\n        // If no query, show popular contacts\n        if (!query.trim()) {\n          setSearchResults(popularContacts);\n          setIsSearching(false);\n          return;\n        }\n\n        // Search through all available profiles (connections, discover, and crew)\n        const     type: 'crew' as const,\n            uid: doc.id,\n            displayName: data.name || data.displayName || &#96;Crew Member ${doc.id.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n            photoURL: data.profileImageUrl Boolean(data.isPublished) : true,\n          };\n        });\n\n        // Combine all sources and filter\n        const allAvailableUsers = [...allUsers, ...crewProfiles];\n        const uniqueUsers = allAvailableUsers.filter((profile, index, self) =\u003e \n          index === self.findIndex(p =\u003e getProfileId(p) === getProfileId(profile))\n        );\n\n        // Create search terms from query for more flexible matching\n        const searchTerms = query.toLowerCase().split(' ').filter(term =\u003e term.length \u003e 0);\n        \n        // Add debugging for search\n        console.log('🔍 Search Debug:', {\n          query,\n          searchTerms,\n          totalUsers: uniqueUsers.length,\n          userEmails: uniqueUsers.map(u =\u003e (u as any).email).filter(Boolean),\n          userNames: uniqueUsers.map(u =\u003e (u as any).name || u.displayName).filter(Boolean)\n        });\n        \n        const filtered = uniqueUsers.filter(profile =\u003e {\n          if (getProfileId(profile) === user.uid) return false;\n          \n          const profileText = [\n            profile.displayName,\n            (profile as any).name,\n            (profile as any).email,\n            (profile as any).username,\n            (profile as any).jobTitles?.[0]?.title,\n            profile.bio\n          ].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();\n          \n          // Check if any search term matches any part of the profile\n          const matches = searchTerms.some(term =\u003e profileText.includes(term));\n          \n          // Debug logging for specific searches\n          if (query.toLowerCase().includes('myfilmjobs') || query.toLowerCase().includes('iam') || profileText,\n              searchTerms,\n              matches\n            });\n          }\n          \n          return matches;\n        });\n\n        setSearchResults(filtered.slice(0, 15));\n  {isSearching ?       "contents": "import React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { db, auth } from '../../firebase';\nimport { doc, setDoc, arrayUnion, arrayRemove } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { useAuthState } from 'react-firebase-hooks/auth';\nimport { cn } from '../../lib/utils';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport { Profile, getDisplayName, getPhotoUrl, isCrewProfile, getProfileId } from '../../types/Profile';\nimport FollowButton from './FollowButton';\nimport { imageErrorFallback } from '../../utilities/imageErrorFallback';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\n\ninterface MemberCardProps {\n  profile: Profile;\n  index?: number;\n  isFiltering?: boolean;\n  currentUserId?: string;\n  className?: string;\n}\n\nconst MemberCard: React.FC\u003cMemberCardProps\u003e = ({ \n  profile, \n  index = 0, \n  isFiltering = false,\n  currentUserId,\n  className = ''\n}) =\u003e {\n  const [user] = useAuthState(auth);\n  const [isBookmarked, setIsBookmarked] = useState(false);\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmark = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!user?.uid || !currentUserId) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      const userRef = doc(db, 'users', currentUserId);\n      const profileId = 'uid' in profile ? profile.uid : profile.id;\n      \n      if (isBookmarked) {\n        await setDoc(userRef, {\n          bookmarkedUsers: arrayRemove(profileId)\n        }, { merge: true });\n        setIsBookmarked(false);\n        toast.success('Crew member removed from favorites');\n      } else {\n        await setDoc(userRef, {\n          bookmarkedUsers: arrayUnion(profileId)\n        }, { merge: true });\n        setIsBookmarked(true);\n        toast.success('Crew member added to favorites!');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error updating bookmark:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to update favorites. Please try again.');\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityColor = (availability?: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!availability) return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    \n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'soon':\n        return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';\n      default:\n        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Get primary job title\n  const primaryJobTitle = isCrewProfile(profile)\n    ? profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || 'Crew Member'\n    : profile.jobTitle || 'Crew Member';\n\n  // Get primary location\n  let primaryLocation = 'Location not specified';\n  if (isCrewProfile(profile) \u0026\u0026 profile.residences?.[0]) {\n    primaryLocation = &#96;${profile.residences[0].city}, ${profile.residences[0].country}&#96;;\n  } else if ('location' in profile \u0026\u0026 profile.location) {\n    primaryLocation = profile.location;\n  }\n\n  const displayName = getDisplayName(profile);\n  const photoUrl = getPhotoUrl(profile);\n  const profileId = getProfileId(profile);\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv \n      className={cn(\n        &#96;group card-base card-hover animate-entrance ${isFiltering ? 'opacity-50 scale-95' : 'opacity-100 scale-100'}&#96;,\n        'flex flex-col items-center p-6',\n        className\n      )}\n      style={{ animationDelay: &#96;${index * 0.1}s&#96;, height: 320, width: '100%' }}\n    \u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"h-48 card-image-container flex flex-col items-center justify-center mb-4\"\u003e\n        \u003cimg \n          src={photoUrl} \n          alt={displayName}\n          className=\"w-20 h-20 rounded-full object-cover mb-2 border-2 border-gray-100 shadow-sm\"\n          onError={imageErrorFallback}\n        /\u003e\n        \n        {/* Bookmark Button */}\n        {user \u0026\u0026 currentUserId \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cbutton\n            onClick={handleBookmark}\n            disabled={isBookmarking}\n            className=\"absolute top-3 right-3 p-2 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-white transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110 disabled:opacity-50\"\n            title={isBookmarked ? \"Remove from bookmarks\" : \"Add to bookmarks\"}\n          \u003e\n            \u003csvg \n              className={&#96;w-5 h-5 ${isBookmarked ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-current' : 'text-gray-600'}&#96;} \n              fill={isBookmarked ? 'currentColor' : 'none'} \n              stroke=\"currentColor\" \n              viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\"\n            \u003e\n              \u003cpath \n                strokeLinecap=\"round\" \n                strokeLinejoin=\"round\" \n                strokeWidth={2} \n                d=\"M5 5a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v16l-7-3.5L5 21V5z\" \n              /\u003e\n            \u003c/svg\u003e\n          \u003c/button\u003e\n        )}\n        \n        {/* Availability Badge */}\n        {('availability' in profile \u0026\u0026 profile.availability) \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"mt-2\"\u003e\n            \u003cspan className={&#96;text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full ${getAvailabilityColor(profile.availability)}&#96;}\u003e\n              {profile.availability}\n            \u003c/span\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \n      \u003cdiv className=\"w-full text-center mb-4\"\u003e\n        \u003ch3 className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-1\"\u003e{displayName}\u003c/h3\u003e\n        \u003cp className=\"text-sm text-gray-600 font-medium mb-1\"\u003e{primaryJobTitle}\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003cp className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\"\u003e{primaryLocation}\u003c/p\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \n      \u003cdiv className=\"w-full flex justify-center gap-3 mt-auto\"\u003e\n        {user \u0026\u0026 user.uid !== profileId \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"w-full\"\u003e\n            \u003cFollowButton \n              currentUserId={user.uid}\n              targetUserId={profileId}\n              className=\"w-full justify-center\"\n            /\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};\n\nexport default MemberCard;\n",

      "relativeWorkspacePath": "src/components/Social/MemberCard.tsx"
    }

        "contents": "\n\nconst CrewBannerCard: React.FC\u003cCrewBannerCardProps\u003e = ({ \n  profile, \n  index = 0, \n  isFiltering = false,\n  currentUserId,\n  isBookmarked = false,\n  onBookmark,\n  className = ''\n}) =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!currentUserId || !onBookmark || isBookmarking) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      await onBookmark(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityColor = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'soon':\n        return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600';\n      default:\n        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityText = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return t('crew.available');\n      case 'soon':\n        return t('crew.soon');\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return t('crew.unavailable');\n      default:\n        return availability;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const mainTitle = profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || t('crew.crewMember');\n  const mainLocation = profile.residences?.[0] ? \n    &#96;${profile.residences[0].city ? profile.residences[0].city + ', ' : ''}${profile.residences[0].country || ''}&#96; : '';\n          const imageUrl = profile.profileImageUrl || '/bust-avatar.svg';\n  const availability = profile.availability || '';",

        "contents": "\n\nconst CrewProfileCard: React.FC\u003cCrewProfileCardProps\u003e = ({ \n  profile, \n  index = 0, \n  isFiltering = false,\n  currentUserId,\n  isBookmarked = false,\n  onBookmark\n}) =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [user] = useAuthState(auth);\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!user || !onBookmark) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      onBookmark(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityColor = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return 'badge-success';\n      case 'soon':\n        return 'badge-warning';\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return 'badge-error';\n      default:\n        return 'badge-gray';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityText = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return t('crew.available');\n      case 'soon':\n        return t('crew.soon');\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return t('crew.unavailable');\n      default:\n        return availability;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const primaryJobTitle = profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || t('crew.crewMember');\n  const primaryLocation = profile.residences?.[0] ? \n    &#96;${profile.residences[0].city}, ${profile.residences[0].country}&#96; : t('crew.locationNotSpecified');",

(profile as any).jobTitles?.[0]?.title : undefined;\n    const location = (profile as any).residences?.[0]?.city || (profile as any).location;\n    \n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-lg border border-gray-200 p-4 hover:shadow-sm transition-shadow\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n          {/* Left side - Avatar and Info */}\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center space-x-3 flex-1 min-w-0\"\u003e\n            {/* Avatar */}\n            \u003cimg \n              src={avatarUrl} \n              alt={displayName}\n              className=\"h-10 w-10 rounded-full object-cover object-center flex-shrink-0\"\n              onError={(e) =\u003e {\n                const target = e.target as HTMLImageElement;\n                target.src = '/bust-avatar.svg';\n              }}\n            /\u003e\n            \n            {/* User Info */}\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex-1 min-w-0\"\u003e\n              \u003ch3 className=\"font-semibold text-gray-900 truncate\" title={displayName}\u003e\n                {displayName}\n              \u003c/h3\u003e\n              {jobTitle \u0026\u0026 (\n                \u003cp className=\"text-sm text-gray-600 truncate\" title={jobTitle}\u003e\n                  {jobTitle}\n                \u003c/p\u003e\n              )}\n              {location \u0026\u0026 (\n                \u003cp className=\"text-xs text-gray-500 truncate\" title={location}\u003e\n                  {location}\n                \u003c/p\u003e\n              )}\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          {/* Right side - Actions */}",

        "contents": "\n\n// Crew Profile Card Component with Animations\nconst CrewProfileCard: React.FC\u003c{ \n  profile: CrewProfile; \n  index: number;\n  isFiltering: boolean;\n  currentUserId: string;\n  isBookmarked: boolean;\n  onBookmarkToggle: (crewId: string, isBookmarked: boolean) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n}\u003e = ({ profile, index, isFiltering, currentUserId, isBookmarked, onBookmarkToggle }) =\u003e {\n  const primaryJob = profile.jobTitles[0];\n  const primaryResidence = profile.residences[0];\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!currentUserId || isBookmarking) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      await onBookmarkToggle(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Crew Profile Card Component with Animations\nconst CrewProfileCard: React.FC\u003c{ \n  profile: CrewProfile; \n  index: number;\n  isFiltering: boolean;\n  currentUserId: string;\n  isBookmarked: boolean;\n  onBookmarkToggle: (crewId: string, isBookmarked: boolean) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n}\u003e = ({ profile, index, isFiltering, currentUserId, isBookmarked, onBookmarkToggle }) =\u003e {\n  const primaryJob = profile.jobTitles[0];\n  const primaryResidence = profile.residences[0];\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!currentUserId || isBookmarking) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      await onBookmarkToggle(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };",

'opacity-50 scale-95' : 'opacity-100 scale-100'}&#96;,\n        'flex flex-col items-center p-6',\n        className\n      )}\n      style={{ animationDelay: &#96;${index * 0.1}s&#96;, height: 320, width: '100%' }}\n    \u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"h-48 card-image-container flex flex-col items-center justify-center mb-4\"\u003e\n        \u003cimg \n          src={photoUrl} \n          alt={displayName}\n          className=\"w-20 h-20 rounded-full object-cover mb-2 border-2 border-gray-100 shadow-sm\"\n          onError={imageErrorFallback}\n        /\u003e\n        \n        {/* Bookmark Button */}\n        {user \u0026\u0026 currentUserId \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cbutton\n            onClick={handleBookmark}\n            disabled={isBookmarking}\n            className=\"absolute top-3 right-3 p-2 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-white transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110 disabled:opacity-50\"\n            title={isBookmarked ? \"Remove from bookmarks\" : \"Add to bookmarks\"}\n          \u003e\n            \u003csvg \n              className={&#96;w-5 h-5 ${isBookmarked ?
